paragraphs: The morning begins by aligning annual brand timing and defining the quarter's promotion theme. At midday, creative and media teams build the plan and confirm channels and budget. Before launch, assets and attribution are reviewed through several revisions. The afternoon brings campaign data, bid and audience adjustments, and project-list cleanup before next week's review.

In one sentence: turn a budget into effective reach. Work includes setting strategy, managing budgets, coordinating creative work, monitoring media buying, reviewing results, and leading teams. It combines analysis and communication at the center of marketing.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 27,000 advertising and promotions managers employed in 2024, falling to a projected 26,400 by 2034. That is a net loss of roughly 600 jobs, with about 2,100 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $127,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
